item.title: California man sentenced for running counterfeit jewelry scheme
item.description: NEW MEXICO (KRQE) – A California man will spend three years in federal prison for running a counterfeit jewelry scheme. A Santa Fe jury convicted Robert Haack last year after he sold the fake jewelry on eBay from 2008 to 2015, scamming 10 people out of $500,000. item.title: Council approves overnight operations for Española shelter
item.description: ESPAÑOLA, N.M. (KRQE) — After years of back and forth with the city, Española city councilors approved continued overnight operations at the Pathway homeless shelter. Wednesday night, council voted 5-to-2 to approve the Española Pathways Shelter's application for a five-year special use permit, allowing them to continue providing overnight shelter to the unhoused population.
